script.spoken: Three Mile Island Unit 2 partially melted down. Cooling water escaped for hours through a valve stuck open. The operators didn't know. Their panel light said the valve was closed. It only showed the close signal was sent, not the valve's position. Thinking there was too much water, they cut emergency cooling. The core overheated and partly melted. That's why control rooms and training were rebuilt afterward.
